findings: No fallback if role query fails — If SupabaseSync.getRole() returns null or rejects, the user is silently treated as viewer, potentially locking an owner out of edit controls. Add a try-catch or default.
Login error message not cleared on new attempt — The error stays visible if the user retries without reloading. Consider clearing .login-error when the form is focused or submitted.

No loading/disabled state persistence — If the user closes the browser tab during await SupabaseSync.pull() after successful login, the diary will re-render in viewer mode on next load (no session in cache). This is correct behavior but not mentioned in docs.

Missing email validation for Supabase — The login form only checks for empty fields; Supabase will reject invalid emails, but the error message will be generic ('Login failed'). Consider client-side validation to give clearer feedback.
Hardcoded timeout for login animation — The 720ms timeout for the flip animation is hardcoded; if the animation CSS changes, this could become out of sync.
